import { openDatabase } from "@mizchi/sqlike";
import { openAotDatabase } from "@mizchi/sqlike/aot";
import { DefinedDatabase } from "@mizchi/sqlike/defined";
import { createDefinedDatabase } from "@mizchi/sqlike/defined/core";
import { definedWasm } from "@mizchi/sqlike/defined/wasm";
import {openAotExecutor,aotExecutorWasm} from "@mizchi/sqlike/aot/core";
import { encodeFrame, decodeFrame } from "@mizchi/litestream/protocol";

// Replaced by the fixture writer with build-time data before serving.
const catalog = __NPM_CATALOG__;
const program = __NPM_NATIVE_PROGRAM__;
let wasmBytes: ArrayBuffer | undefined;
let aotBytes: ArrayBuffer | undefined;
(globalThis as unknown as { npmCheck: () => Promise<unknown> }).npmCheck = async () => {
  const db = openDatabase();
  if (db.values("SELECT 7")[0]?.[0] !== 7n) throw Error("browser SQL mismatch");
  db.close();
  const native = openAotDatabase(program);
  const blob = Uint8Array.of(0,255);
  native.execute("add",[1n,12.5,"typed",blob]);blob[0]=99;
  const statement = native.prepare("get"), typed = statement.get([1n]);
  if (typed?.[0] !== 1n || typed[1] !== 12.5 || (typed[3] as Uint8Array)[0] !== 0) throw Error("browser native AOT mismatch");
  statement.finalize();native.close();
  const aotBinary=aotBytes??=await fetch('/node_modules/@mizchi/sqlike/dist/wasm/aot.wasm').then(r=>r.arrayBuffer());
  const aotInstance=(await WebAssembly.instantiate(aotBinary,{},{builtins:['js-string'],importedStringConstants:'_'})).instance;
  const executor=openAotExecutor(aotExecutorWasm(aotInstance.exports),program);
  executor.execute('add',[1n,12.5,'executor',new Uint8Array([0,255])]);
  if(executor.execute('get',[1n]).rows[0]?.[2]!=='executor')throw Error('browser executor mismatch');
  executor.close();
  const fixed = await DefinedDatabase.open("npmpackage", catalog);
  await fixed.execute("add", [1n, "persistent"]);
  const rows = (await fixed.prepare("get").all()).map(row => row.map(value => typeof value === "bigint" ? String(value) : value));
  await fixed.close();
  const bytes = wasmBytes ??= await fetch("/node_modules/@mizchi/sqlike/dist/wasm/defined.wasm").then(r=>r.arrayBuffer());
  const { instance } = await WebAssembly.instantiate(bytes, {}, { builtins: ["js-string"], importedStringConstants: "_" });
  const wasm = await createDefinedDatabase(definedWasm(instance.exports)).memory(catalog);
  await wasm.execute("add", [1n, "wasm"]);
  if ((await wasm.prepare("get").get())?.[1] !== "wasm") throw Error("browser Wasm mismatch");
  await wasm.close();
  const frame = {kind:1 as const,base:0,opId:crypto.randomUUID(),payload:new Uint8Array([1,2])};
  const decoded = decodeFrame(encodeFrame(frame));
  return { rows, protocol: decoded.opId === frame.opId, wasm: true };
};
